EN: She's equally adept at pulling a sled... and your heartstrings.
ZH: 它擅长拉动雪橇……和你的心弦。

EN: He served our troops in Anchorage. Now he proudly serves the Vault.
ZH: 它曾在安克雷奇为我们的军队服务。现在它自豪地为避难所服务。

EN: Loves keeping humans as pets.
ZH: 就爱把人类当宠物养。

EN: Thinks mice were created for his own personal amusement.
ZH: 认为老鼠是为了供它玩耍而被创造的。

EN: Looks like he's fresh out of the dryer.
ZH: 看起来像是刚从烘干机中出来。

EN: A fancy coat, and the attitude to match.
ZH: 它一身华丽的皮毛，还有与之相配的傲气。

EN: Those ears can hear you serving cat food from a mile away.
ZH: 那些耳朵能听到你在一英里外喂猫食。

EN: Strikes silently... at least where your toes are concerned.
ZH: 默默地攻击……至少在你的脚趾那里。

EN: Only looks like a wild child. He's as calm and cuddly as they come.
ZH: 只是看起来像一个野孩子。它其实文静又可爱。

EN: He misses the great outdoors. But not much.
ZH: 它怀恋美好的户外活动。但没有那么想。

EN: Your best friend, as long as you have tuna.
ZH: 只要你有金枪鱼，它就是你最好的朋友。

EN: To nap, or not to nap: that is the question.
ZH: 小睡一会，还是不睡：这是一个问题。

EN: Runs in circles endlessly. Chasing what? Exactly.
ZH: 无休止地转圈圈。到底在追着什么？真是搞不懂。

EN: Don't mention his tail, don't mention his tail...
ZH: 别提它的尾巴，别提它的尾巴……

EN: Can sing America the Beautiful... or swear at the Overseer.
ZH: 能唱《美丽的美利坚》……也能咒骂监督者。

EN: Loyal but hungry. Wants a cracker, but Sugar Bombs will do in a pinch.
ZH: 忠诚但总是觉得饿。想要一块饼干，但关键时候糖衣炸弹麦片也行。

EN: Knows 200 words, but will only say “Tunnel Snakes Rule!”
ZH: 知道200个词，却只会说“隧道蛇统治一切！”

EN: The closest you'll get to an ocelot. Revolver not included.
ZH: 你最多能得到一只虎猫。可别想还会有什么左轮手枪。

EN: He's got more spots than sense, but you'll love him all the same.
ZH: 它身上的斑点比脑子还多，但你还是会一样喜欢它。

EN: Rumor has it there's a cat somewhere under all that fur.
ZH: 有传言说，那一大堆皮草下面有一只猫。

EN: Frequently mistaken for a feather duster.
ZH: 经常被误认为是一个鸡毛掸子。

EN: Long hair, round face, maximum cuddle factor.
ZH: 长长的毛发，圆圆的脸蛋，带给你最暖的抱抱。

EN: The first cat to enter space. The last to leave your heart.
ZH: 第一只进入太空的猫。最后一只离开你心的猫。

EN: Queen of the Wasteland.
ZH: 废土皇后。

EN: Your stop for effective canine security.
ZH: 满足你犬类安保需求的首选。

EN: Don't let the bad rap fool you - he's as loyal as can be.
ZH: 别被它的坏名声骗了——它忠诚无比。

EN: Underneath all those muscles, there's a big heart.
ZH: 在这些健壮的肌肉下面，有一颗宽厚的心。

EN: Your Vault couldn't ask for a better guard dog.
ZH: 你的避难所不可能再找到比它更好的看门狗了。

EN: Don't misjudge this fancy pants – he's smart, sweet and strong.
ZH: 别被这身花哨行头骗了——它聪明、乖巧又强壮。

EN: Wanted a mohawk. Got... this. He's a hero on the inside.
ZH: 想要一个莫霍克。得到了……这个。它内心是一个英雄。

EN: A friend's preserved mind, mundane tidiness its key anchor to sanity.
ZH: 保存着朋友的大脑，日常的整洁是它维系理智的关键。

EN: Big and bad, but devoted and obedient. He's a friend for life.
ZH: 它个头大又不好惹，却忠心又听话，会是你一辈子的朋友。

EN: Benign soul in a brawny bod. She's love and loyalty exemplified.
ZH: 一个强壮的身体里住着善良的灵魂。它是爱和忠诚的典范。

EN: Avast, matey! He'll keep you company while you're swabbing the poop deck.
ZH: 且慢，兄弟！在你擦拭甲板的时候它会一直陪伴你。

EN: He'll happily sit on your shoulder. Angel, devil... or both.
ZH: 它会高兴地坐在你肩膀上。是天使，还是恶魔……或两者都是。

EN: Look, sometimes my ears fold back. Let's not make it a thing.
ZH: 看，我的耳朵也会向后折叠。这不算什么。

EN: A happy-go-lucky little gal, but a tad sensitive about her ears.
ZH: 一个无忧无虑的小伙伴，就是耳朵有点敏感。

EN: Not stuck up... just better than you.
ZH: 不是傲慢……就是比你强。

EN: The prettiest, most patient princess on the planet.
ZH: 地球上最美最有耐心的小公主。

EN: Wants to be outside when in, and come inside when out.
ZH: 在外面的时候想进去，在里面的时候又想出去。

EN: Your own little four-legged starlet.
ZH: 属于你自己的四条腿小明星。

EN: Because who wouldn't want a hairless cat?! Right?!
ZH: 你以为谁不想要一只无毛猫吗？！有谁吗？！

EN: Thinks she's a goddess. May not be wrong.
ZH: 它认为自己是女神。也许它并没有错。

EN: If you're ever lost in the Alpine, expect him to come running.
ZH: 如果你在高山上迷失了，希望它能跑来找你。

EN: Cask of Nuka-Cola not included.
ZH: 不包括核子可乐罐。

EN: A lot safer than the full-sized version.
ZH: 比完整版的更安全。

EN: Not nearly as fierce as he looks.
ZH: 一点都不像看上去那么凶。

EN: Thinks every day is Caturday.
ZH: 认为天天都是爱猫日。

EN: A true aristocrat.
ZH: 一个真正的贵族。

EN: Struggling with a catnip addiction, but still adorable.
ZH: 容易对猫薄荷上瘾。但还是很可爱。

EN: “I once shot a Deathclaw in my pajamas. How he got in my pajamas I'll never know.”
ZH: 我曾经穿着睡衣射杀了一只死爪。至于它是怎么钻进我睡衣里的，我永远也不会知道。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 消灭领头死爪。

EN: In that case, sign me up!
ZH: 如果是那样的话，让我加入你们吧！

EN: Thank goodness you're here! I'm all alone and my supplies have run out.
ZH: 谢天谢地你在这里！只剩我一个人了，所有的物资也用光了。

EN: Your troubles are over. The Vault's got everything you need.
ZH: 你可以不用苦恼了。你需要的东西避难所里都有。

EN: One of your Wasteland explorers has heard a cry for help that's coming from a Red Rocket fuel station. Time to rush to the rescue!
ZH: 一名废土探险者听到了一声呼救，是从红火箭服务站传来的。赶紧前去救援吧！

EN: A Cry for Help
ZH: 大声呼救

EN: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
ZH: 调查红火箭服务站。

EN: Someone in a Red Rocket Truck Stop is calling for help.
ZH: 红火箭服务站里有人在大声呼救。

EN: All right. Hope you Dwellers know what you're doing.
ZH: 好吧。希望你们知道自己在做什么。

EN: Come and get me!
ZH: 来抓我啊！

EN: Fine, but it's not going to help ya.
ZH: 好吧，但这可帮不了你。

EN: You fools. The Gobbler can't be stopped! It killed all my men.
ZH: 真是群傻瓜。你们是无法阻止高步勒的！它杀死了我所有的伙伴。

EN: It was just a whirlwind of claws, snack cake crumbles and murder!
ZH: 那是一阵旋风爪，蛋糕碎和谋杀！

EN: Last I saw, it was gorging itself on Salisbury Steak, spewing gravy everywhere...
ZH: 最后一次看到它，它正在狼吞虎咽地吃着索尔斯伯利牛肉饼，肉汁溅得到处都是……

EN: Want to find the Gobbler? Just follow the gravy!
ZH: 想要找到高步勒吗？顺着肉汁就行了！

EN: Give us your weapon. We're taking down the Gobbler!
ZH: 给我们你的武器吧。我们会拿下高步勒的！

EN: Thanks for the intel. Now die, you Raider scumbag!
ZH: 谢谢你的情报。现在去死吧，你们这些掠夺者人渣！

EN: We need your best armor if we're going up against the Gobbler!
ZH: 如果要对付高步勒的话，我们会需要你最好的装备！

EN: I don't know if it'll help, but take this!
ZH: 我不知道是否有帮助，但拿着这个吧！

EN: Thank you. I'll be a model Vault citizen, I swear!
ZH: 谢谢。我会成为一个模范避难所居民的，我发誓！

EN: Maybe this will keep you safe?
ZH: 也许这个会保你安全？

EN: The Gobbler was here!
ZH: 高步勒之前在这里！

EN: It jumped in a vat of Blamco Cranberry Sauce after killing a bunch of Raiders!
ZH: 它杀了一群掠夺者之后跳进了一个布兰科蔓越莓酱的大桶里！

EN: So much cranberry... And blood...
ZH: 这么多的蔓越莓……和血……

EN: You want to track it down? Well, I think you know what to do...
ZH: 你们想找到它？我想你知道该怎么做……

EN: Do you have any weapons that can help us?
ZH: 你有没有什么武器能帮助我们的？

EN: You've lost everything. Why not start a new life in our Vault?
ZH: 你失去了一切，为什么不在我们的避难所开始新生活呢？

EN: How about some armor to help us fight the Gobbler?
ZH: 你们有没有什么好的装备来帮助我们打败高步勒？

EN: We've followed the Gobbler's trail of snack cakes to the Blamco factory.
ZH: 我们顺着高步勒的蛋糕碎来到了布兰科工厂。

EN: A Delicious Trail of Danger!
ZH: 美味的危险踪迹！

EN: Continue tracking down the Gobbler.
ZH: 继续追踪高步勒。

EN: Follow the Gobbler's trail to the Blamco factory.
ZH: 沿着高步勒的踪迹去布兰科工厂。

EN: A ghastly Glowing One has taken up residence a little too close to the Vault, and it's drawing in Ghouls like moths to a flame. Extinguish the brilliant beacon before this Ghoulish gathering grows any larger!
ZH: 可怕的发光种占领了一处居所，离避难所很近。其他的尸鬼像飞蛾扑火般地朝他涌了过来。趁着尸鬼团伙还没有扩张太快的时候，赶紧干掉这个恐怖的绿光“灯塔”！

EN: A Gathering of Ghouls
ZH: 一群尸鬼

EN: Eliminate the Glowing One.
ZH: 除掉发光种。

EN: Confront a Glowing One and its Ghoul minions.
ZH: 迎战一只发光种及其尸鬼爪牙。

EN: Suit yourself, Dwellers!
ZH: 请随意，居民们！

EN: Well, I'd have to ask my supervisor, but I think this can be arranged.
ZH: 那么，我得问问我的领导，但我觉得这个应该是能够安排的。

EN: I SAID, VACATE THE... Ah, just shoot them!
ZH: 我说，清空……呃，给我开枪就是了！

EN: Hold it right there!
ZH: 等等，慢点儿！

EN: This cave is under the dominion of the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 这个洞穴现在属于钢铁兄弟会。

EN: We will soon transform it into a new bunker.
ZH: 我们马上会把它改造成一个新的碉堡。

EN: Vacate the premises immediately - or else!
ZH: 马上清空这个地基——不然的话！

EN: We choose “else.”
ZH: 我们选择“不然的话”。

EN: We just want to have a wedding here... Care to officiate it?
ZH: 我们只想在这里举行一个婚礼……可以帮忙主持吗？

EN: Sorry, can't hear over all that laughter inside my head.
ZH: 抱歉，我脑子里笑声太大，听不清你在说什么。

EN: Well, that's unfortunate. I guess we'll have to kill you.
ZH: 呃，很不幸。我想恐怕得杀了你。

EN: There is? We are so outta here... Come on gang, we're moving on up!
ZH: 是么？真是不想待在这里了……兄弟们，我们继续朝上走！

EN: Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice... Won't get fooled again!
ZH: 骗我一次，是你们可耻。骗我第二次……绝不会再上当！
